title: Intel 10G SFP+ 850NM Short Range Module 10GBASE-SR Optical Transceiver

items.h: Speed: Up to 10 Gbps data transfer
Wavelength: 850 nm (optimized for multimode fiber links)
Maximum Reach: Up to 300 meters on OM3 fiber

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Boost your network performance with the Intel 10G SFP+ 850nm Short Range Module — a reliable, high-speed optical transceiver designed for 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GBASE-SR) applications. Ideal for data centers, enterprise LANs, and server connections, this Intel-certified SFP+ module delivers fast, efficient, and stable optical connectivity over multimode fiber.


Key Features


  • Model: ARH2PA6
  • Speed: Up to 10 Gbps data transfer
  • Wavelength: 850 nm (optimized for multimode fiber links)
  • Form Factor: SFP+ (Small Form-factor Pluggable Plus)
  • Connector Type: LC duplex
  • Fiber Type: Multimode Fiber (MMF – OM3/OM4)
  • Maximum Reach: Up to 300 meters on OM3 fiber
  • Standards Supported: IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-SR
  • Digital Diagnostics (DDM/DOM): Supported for real-time monitoring
  • Plug-and-Play: Hot-pluggable interface for easy installation
